text: Although the positives are often overlooked, break ups can actually be extremely beneficial. <break time="0.8s" /> Separation enables people to escape unfulfilling, negative, and even harmful relationships, promoting feelings of relief, empowerment, and excitement about future possibilities. <break time="0.8s" /> Furthermore, even when left devastated with a broken heart and shattered dreams, all is not lost as individuals are likely to experience growth. <break time="0.8s" /> Tashiro and Frazier found that after the end of a relationship, individuals reported greater self confidence, improvements in communication strategies, better relationships with others, and more positive expectations about future relationships. <break time="0.8s" /> As with other significant life events, break ups can act as a catalyst for making big life changes, enabling individuals to grow beyond their previous level of psychological functioning. <break time="0.8s" /> In sum, while relationship breakdowns can clearly be very stressful, maybe it is time to change the narrative away from the doom and gloom of break ups and, acknowledging that most relationships are finite, view separation not just as an end but as a new opportunity to grow and better ourselves.
